Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Content Migration Specialist position. With my background in digital marketing, content management, and CMS work, I am confident in my ability to support your client's website migration and ensure a smooth launch.

In my current role at Episto, I manage WordPress sites end-to-end, including content uploads, page updates, and structuring content according to templates. I am detail-oriented and experienced in reviewing content for consistency and quality. My technical SEO background also gives me insight into metadata and tagging best practices.

I am comfortable working with stakeholders and coordinating with project managers to meet deadlines. I am based in Zwijndrecht, near Antwerp, and am available to work on site in Brussels. I have a good level of English and Dutch (B1, currently improving), and I am eager to apply my skills to your project.

I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to your team. Thank you for your consideration.

Best regards,

Dear Hiring Team,

I am excited to apply for the Content Migration Specialist role. With a strong foundation in digital marketing, content management, and CMS platforms, I am well-prepared to support your client's website migration and ensure a successful launch.

In my current position as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I manage client websites built on WordPress, handling content uploads, page updates, and structuring content according to templates. This hands-on experience has honed my ability to organize content systematically, ensuring it is consistent and ready for publication. I am meticulous about quality and detail, which is essential for reviewing content and ensuring correct metadata and tagging.

My technical background includes front-end development (AngularJS, JavaScript) and coursework in applied computer science, giving me a solid understanding of web architecture and CMS workflows. I have also implemented structured data and performed technical SEO audits on my own project, mirook.com, which demonstrates my ability to work independently and proactively identify issues.

I am comfortable collaborating with diverse stakeholders, as I regularly coordinate with clients and team members to meet deadlines. My organizational skills allow me to manage multiple tasks in parallel, and I am always looking for ways to improve processes. I am based in Zwijndrecht, near Antwerp, and am available to work on site in Brussels as preferred.

I am fluent in English and Turkish, with a B1 level in Dutch that I am actively improving. I am eager to bring my CMS expertise and attention to detail to your team. Thank you for considering my application; I look forward to the opportunity to contribute to your project.
